body: This PR adds two options to the 0M microphysics: 1. With PrognosticEDMFX, updraft condensate precipitates with its own timescale, `precipitation_timescale_updraft_ratio` × `precipitation_timescale` (ratio 1 by default). The thresholds (`S_0`, `qc_0`) are shared with the grid mean. 2. Optional below-cloud evaporation/sublimation of the precipitation flux, switched on with the YAML option `precipitation_evaporation_0m: "Kessler"` (default `~`, off). Evaporated water returns to the grid mean with the energy it was removed with; if all precipitation evaporates, the surface precipitation energy flux is zero. The rate and parameters are in CloudMicrophysics and ClimaParams (versions already on main; no compat change). Results are unchanged with the defaults. New diagnostics: `prup`, `prevap`, `tnhusevp`. CI: the TRMM 0M EDMF job (`prognostic_edmfx_trmm_column_0M`) now runs with evaporation on (ClimaParams default coefficient). ToDo - [ ] move new parameters to ClimaParams Outcomes: Improves upper atmosphere humidity errors across the board, and zonal mean temperature biases. (blue is baseline/main behavior, green is this PR) The split timescale + reevaporation removes upper atmosphere mean temperature biases and reduces lower atmosphere warm biases (a is baseline/main behavior, e is this PR) This also appears to address too little ice in the upper troposphere.
title: 0m: Add split up-env timescale, add reevaporation

body:
Retunes the turbulent lateral entrainment `E_turb(a) = c₁ exp(-c₂ a)` in `toml/prognostic_edmfx_1M.toml` and `toml/prognostic_edmfx_1M_mlcloud.toml` from `[0.001, 1e5]` to `[0.007, 400.0]`.

With the old values, the characteristic area scale `1 / c₂ = 1e-5` equaled `EDMF_min_area`, so `E_turb` was negligible (< 5e-8 s⁻¹) for every updraft with `a ≥ 1e-4`. The new values place it at `a = 0.0025`:

- Broad boundary-layer updrafts (`a ~ 0.06–0.16`) stay undiluted (`exp(-400 a) < 4e-11`).
- Narrow shallow-cumulus plumes mix tracers with the environment: `E_turb` = 3e-3, 1e-3, and 2e-5 s⁻¹ at `a` = 0.002, 0.005, and 0.015.
- Extinguished drafts (`a = 1e-5`) relax toward the environment on a timescale `1 / c₁ ≈ 143 s`.

`E_turb` acts only on updraft scalars, not on the updraft mass `ρa`.

Reduces vertical LWP/RWP oscillations in RICO/BOMEX somewhat. However, there still are stong temporal oscillations.

### Other changes
- `ref_counter` bumped to 470 (the DYCOMS_RF02, Rico, and TRMM reproducibility jobs use `prognostic_edmfx_1M.toml`).
- NEWS entry.
title: Retune turbulent lateral entrainment in the 1M prognostic EDMFX parameter files

body:
Evaluates the linearized saturation-excess variance as `(σ_q − γ σ_T)² + 2 γ σ_T σ_q (1 − corr)`, which keeps its precision where `σ_q ≈ γ σ_T` and `corr ≈ 1`, and clamps the correlation of `T′` and `S′` to `[−1, 1]` in `sgs_temperature_regression`. With the expanded form, `σ_S` collapsed to its floor in `Float32` and node temperatures of the 1M conditional-moment rule reached the temperature floor.

Bumps `ref_counter` to 471.
title: Eliminate Float32 cancellation in the saturation-excess width
